ai.brief: ’” Then, in a follow-up post on Saturday, Delangue outlined what he’d asked for from OpenAI. ” Delangue added, “The first autonomous agent cyberattack is an unprecedented event. ” Despite the autonomous nature of the attack, cybersecurity experts suggested that it could also be blamed on human error — namely, OpenAI’s apparent failure to properly configure what should have been a fully isolated testing environment.
